title: Pitching to Publishers Sucks (& What We Learned Pitching Cabernet)
description: Arseniy Klishin from Party for Introverts shares the tips and tricks he wishes he knew while securing funding and a publishing deal for their recent narrative RPG Cabernet. In his talk he provides an array of developer-friendly insights and advice about the pitching process, developing prototypes, making adjustments to the pitch and demo based on publisher feedback, and more.
session_takeaway: Gain an increased confidence in your pitching abilities and understand meetings from the developer perspective.
A breakdown of what to expect from pitch meetings and publisher expectations.
Repeatable strategies for making improvements to demos based on active industry feedback.
